text: Next day, travelling back: Holmes says he is indirectly responsible for Dr. Roylott's death, and that it will not weigh heavily on him
why: Paragraph 247 places the return journey on the next day, and paragraph 251 has Holmes say he is indirectly responsible and it will not weigh heavily on his conscience.

text: That night: Holmes's blows drive the creature back through the ventilator, its temper roused
why: Paragraphs 249-251 state that Holmes struck at the creature, drove it through the ventilator, and roused its temper; the events are set on the night of the vigil.

text: Did Holmes mean the snake to reach its master when he struck at it?
why: A plain question that paragraph 251 gives reason to consider, since Holmes raises his own indirect responsibility for the death.

text: Did Holmes mean the snake to reach its master when he struck at it? — he meant only to foil the attempt, and accepts the death as a result
id: q.holmes_foresaw=he meant only to foil the attempt, and accepts the death as a result
why: Holmes says he attacked the snake to drive it back through the ventilator and accepts the death as a consequence, so intent to foil with acceptance of the result is a reasonable reading.

text: Did Holmes mean the snake to reach its master when he struck at it? — he thought it likely the snake would go back and strike its master
id: q.holmes_foresaw=he thought it likely the snake would go back and strike its master
why: A candidate answer about Holmes's foresight that paragraph 251 gives the reader reason to consider; the text does not confirm it, but it is offered as a possibility rather than a stated fact.

text: Why did Julia live on after the bite when Dr. Roylott died within seconds? — the snake that bit him had been roused and struck harder
id: q.julia_lingered=the snake that bit him had been roused and struck harder
why: The story never says Julia was bitten or how long she survived after a bite; it only says she convulsed and slowly died. The 'struck harder' explanation is not in the text, and the question's wording presupposes a bite and an interval the story does not supply.
